# Sales Management Project

## Programming Fundamentals

### First Delivery

This project corresponds to the first delivery of the Programming Fundamentals course project.

The program automatically generates sample files that will be used as input for future deliveries of the project.

## Main Class

GenerateInfoFiles

## Generated Files

The program generates:

- products.txt
- salesmen_info.txt
- salesman_1001.txt
- salesman_1002.txt
- salesman_1003.txt
- salesman_1004.txt
- salesman_1005.txt

## Products File Format

```text
ProductId;ProductName;ProductPrice
```
